summary: NJP Associates is Norman J. Politziner's one-principal financial planning and insurance practice at 47 Raritan Ave in Highland Park, NJ, serving retirees, families and business owners across northern/central New Jersey for more than 40 years, with a free initial meeting offered by phone or email. The front door is thin: a 4-field contact form and a phone number that is not tappable, no online scheduling, an unclaimed Google profile categorised as an 'Insurance agency', and blog content untouched since March 2024. SEC/FINRA records show his investment adviser registration lapsed on 05/18/2026 while the site still describes him as an IAR of Koehler Asset Management, so the published affiliations and the regulatory record no longer line up.

facts.fact: Practice address, phone, fax and email: 47 Raritan Ave, Highland Park, NJ 08904; P 732-296-9355; F 732-296-9377; info@politziner.com, with an embedded Google map of the address.
Home page says Norman J. Politziner, CFP and NJP Associates have helped people plan for the future for more than 40 years and 'welcome your call or email', offering a free, no-obligation meeting.

Services cover financial, retirement and investment planning, life/health/disability/long-term-care insurance, estate and trust work and business succession; clients are retirees and pre-retirees, individuals and families, and business owners in northern and central New Jersey and 'around the country'.
Norman J. Politziner, CFP, MBA, CeFT is described as president of NJP Associates, CFP since 1983, in the financial services industry since 1978; the same page's heading labels him 'Partner'.
Ali Okoh is listed as Operations Manager / Senior Branch Office Administrator, 13 years in the industry and more than nine with NJP Associates, and is a Notary Public.
Bill Koehler is listed as a Partner; his bio describes him as a Wealth Manager for Kingsview Wealth Management running that firm's Lindenhurst, NY branch.

The Contact page form has exactly four fields - Your Name, Your Email, Subject, Message - with a 'Send message' button; the DOM contains no tel: or mailto: links, so the phone number and email are plain text.

The Google Maps profile for NJP Associates is categorised 'Insurance agency', shows 47 Raritan Ave #2B, phone (732) 296-9355, 'Open - Closes 9 PM', no star rating or reviews, and displays 'Claim this business' (i.e. unclaimed).

A Bing business listing for NJP Associates shows the same address and phone, hours of 8 AM-9 PM Monday-Friday and Sunday with Saturday closed, and 'Services offered' of Auto Insurance, Workers Compensation Insurance and Life Insurance.

SEC/FINRA IAPD report (last updated 05/18/2026) states Norman Jay Politziner is not currently registered as an Investment Adviser Representative; his last IAR registration was Kingsview Wealth Management, LLC (09/25/2018-05/18/2026, Highland Park NJ), previously ESI Financial Advisors (2002-2018); NJP Associates is his DBA since Dec 2002, where he is president doing financial services/fixed insurance sales; no disclosure events.

Footer disclosure says Norman Politziner is an Investment Advisor Representative of Koehler Asset Management and that advisory services are offered through Koehler Asset Management, an SEC-registered adviser.
'News You Can Use' blog holds four posts, every one dated March 7, 2024; the 'Events' and 'FAQ' URLs return pages containing only the site footer.

operations_signals: Intake runs on a phone call to 732-296-9355, email to info@politziner.com, or a generic 4-field contact form (name, email, subject, message); there is no calendar, booking widget or qualifying questionnaire anywhere on the site (https://www.politziner.com/contact).

The contact page publishes the phone as plain text with 0 tel: links and 0 mailto: links (verified in the page DOM), so a 390 px mobile visitor must copy the number or email by hand (https://www.politziner.com/contact).

Hours are not published on the firm's own site at all; the Google profile says 'Closes 9 PM' and the Bing listing says 8 AM-9 PM Mon-Fri and Sun, Saturday closed, which for a one-adviser office suggests auto-generated hours and likely voicemail for evening callers (https://www.google.com/maps/place/NJP+Associates/@40.4981312,-74.4370936,17z).

No after-hours coverage, answering service or response-time promise is stated on the site; the only commitments are 'we welcome your call or email' and a free no-obligation meeting (https://www.politziner.com/).
Client self-service is a single link to the Schwab Retirement Center login on an otherwise blank 'View Your Account' page (https://www.politziner.com/view-your-account).
Requests for CPA continuing-education credits are routed to the same generic /contact page rather than a dedicated scheduler (https://www.politziner.com/njp-difference).

The Google profile is unclaimed and categorised 'Insurance agency', so hours, category and service list are being set by Google/Bing rather than the firm (https://www.google.com/maps/place/NJP+Associates/@40.4981312,-74.4370936,17z).
hiring_signals: No current or recent job postings were found for NJP Associates on the open web, and the site has no careers page in its sitemap (https://www.politziner.com/sitemap.xml).

The visible bench is one principal, one operations manager and one partner; the About Us disclosures also name three support staff who are not registered representatives, indicating a very small administrative team (https://www.politziner.com/about-us).
review_themes: No customer reviews: the Google profile shows no star rating and no reviews, and invites the visitor to 'Write a review' (https://www.google.com/maps/place/NJP+Associates/@40.4981312,-74.4370936,17z).

Experience.com's profile for Norman Politziner returns 'no reviews found' and lists him as an insurance agent with specialties in annuities, health insurance and life insurance (https://www.experience.com/reviews/norman-12828066).

No review content about wait times, billing or scheduling exists in the sources opened, so no service-quality themes can be summarised (https://www.google.com/maps/place/NJP+Associates/@40.4981312,-74.4370936,17z).
tech_footprint: Site runs Drupal 10 on the advisor.ws/AdvisorWebsites platform with a 'powered by snappykraken.com/websites' footer credit (https://www.politziner.com/).
Analytics stack is Google Tag Manager (GTM-PDR56SM) plus GA4 (G-FEGRJ7CK5E); no chat widget, CRM embed or booking tool is loaded (https://www.politziner.com/).
Contact form is a Drupal Webform protected by the antibot/honeypot module, with fixed fields and no routing or qualification logic (https://www.politziner.com/contact).
No JSON-LD structured data and no meta description on the home page; page titles are generic ('Home | NJP Associates.') (https://www.politziner.com/).
Content marketing has stalled: four blog posts, all dated March 7, 2024, and unused Events and FAQ pages that render only the footer (https://www.politziner.com/blog).
Client login is outsourced to Schwab Retirement Center via a single outbound link (https://www.politziner.com/view-your-account).
growth_signals: No expansion, new office or acquisition found; the practice still lists only the single Highland Park address (https://www.politziner.com/contact).

Regulatory change rather than growth: his investment adviser registration with Kingsview ended 05/18/2026 and IAPD shows no current IAR registration, while the site still claims a Koehler Asset Management IAR relationship (https://reports.adviserinfo.sec.gov/reports/individual/individual_711308.pdf).

Referral hooks are in place but manual: the firm advertises approval to give continuing-education credits to CPAs and publishes a 'Wit List' process PDF and a life-insurance formula PDF as lead magnets (https://www.politziner.com/njp-difference).
Marketing output has stopped rather than scaled - the newest blog post is from March 2024 and the e-newsletter sign-up is a static footer graphic (https://www.politziner.com/blog).
physical_signals: Single office at 47 Raritan Ave, Suite 2B, Highland Park, NJ 08904, shown as a pin on the embedded Google map (https://www.politziner.com/contact).

Google and Bing listings both carry the '#2B' suite designation, consistent with a small upper-floor office suite rather than a street-level branch (https://www.bing.com/maps?q=NJP+Associates+47+Raritan+Ave+Highland+Park+NJ).

No square footage, seat count, fleet, warehouse or equipment is stated in any source opened; this is a desk-based advisory/insurance practice with no physical inventory (https://www.politziner.com/about-njp).
Google Maps records the location as FHX8+75 Highland Park, New Jersey, on Raritan Ave near the Route 27 business strip (https://www.google.com/maps/place/NJP+Associates/@40.4981312,-74.4370936,17z).
decision_maker: Norman J. Politziner, CFP, MBA, CeFT - president of NJP Associates (bio heading also labels him 'Partner'), https://www.politziner.com/team-member/norman-j-politziner

inferences.inference: The site's Koehler Asset Management disclosure is likely out of date and the practice may be winding down or shifting to insurance-only work.
inferences.reasoning: IAPD (updated 05/18/2026) says he is not currently registered as an IAR and his last registration (Kingsview) ended that date, while the site still claims a Koehler IAR role; the newest site content is from March 2024, so the disclosure block was probably never revised. NJP Associates is registered in his record as financial services/fixed insurance sales, which still fits insurance commissions.

inferences.inference: Inbound inquiries are triaged manually by a single operations manager.
inferences.reasoning: There is no CRM, chat or booking widget in the page source, only a generic four-field form and a phone number; Ali Okoh is the only named operations/administrative role, so scheduling, paperwork and follow-up plausibly sit with one person.

inferences.inference: After-hours and mobile inquiry capture is the weakest link in the front door.
inferences.reasoning: Listings advertise a 9 PM close that a one-adviser practice is unlikely to staff, the site publishes no hours or after-hours promise, and the phone is not a tel: link on a mobile page whose hero is a stock photo with no CTA - so evening or on-the-go prospects likely reach voicemail or abandon.

inferences.inference: Any agent work here is more likely compliance- and follow-up-oriented than lead-generation-oriented.
inferences.reasoning: A 40-year practice with an unclaimed Google profile and zero reviews is not competing on inbound search; the visible manual load is intake logging, meeting scheduling, CE/referral coordination and keeping affiliations/disclosures consistent across site, ADV and listings.

data_gaps: Google search results were blocked by a bot-check page, so the review count could only be read from the Google Maps place panel, which shows no rating and no reviews; the actual review count is therefore unconfirmed.
Alignable reportedly shows five recommendations for NJP Associates, but the page returned HTTP 429 and could not be opened, so that is unverified and excluded from review themes.
No job board listing, careers page or recent hiring activity was found for this practice.
The firm publishes no office hours, fee schedule, account minimums or AUM for NJP Associates; the Koehler Asset Management ADV figures belong to a separate RIA and were not used.
Could not determine whether the practice is still taking new advisory clients after the 05/18/2026 registration lapse, or whether the site's Koehler disclosure reflects a pending new affiliation.
Listing data (category, hours, service list) on Google and Bing may be auto-generated or stale; no source confirms the firm supplied it.
No square footage, headcount or ownership/entity filing details were found in public sources.
